---
title: "Create & remove user"
---

<Steps>
  <Step title="Select the partner">

    - To create a new user to a Partner, first select the Partner that the user belong to.

  </Step>

  <Step title="Open the Users view">

    Change the view from 'Overview' to 'Users'

    ![An image from the static](/images/partners-user3-07ffd70db97251481a740df69f38a7cd.png)

  </Step>

  <Step title="Press '+Add user'">

    Next step is to press '+Add user'

    ![An image from the static](/images/partners-user2-f7b2c382e2b33df05f10483c5e977087.png)

  </Step>

  <Step title="Specify the user details">

    Specify the following before adding the new user:

    - Name - Register the users first and last name.
    - Email - Register the users email.
    - Partner - Choose the Partner the user belong to.
    - Segment - Choose the right level of access which shall be visible to that user.
    - Default language - Choose the default language used by the user.

    <Tip>

    </Tip>

    <Warning>

    </Warning>

    ![An image from the static](data:image/png;base64,)

  </Step>
</Steps>
